title: Promotion With Check
setup: Both sides have a pawn one step from queening, and it is your move.
hint: Your new queen must also stop Black's pawn. A check gives it the time.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{a8=Q+}} promotes with check. Black must spend its move on the king, and then {{Qh1}} blocks the h-pawn one square short of queening. Anything slower, such as {{Kc2}}, lets {{h1=Q}}, and you are left queen against queen.

In a race, the promotion that gives check is worth a whole tempo.
